uzo.purpose: Starts an action on the current view: it saves, sends, confirms, cancels or deletes something here.

instead.kialo: A setting that stays on or off needs a control that shows its state, because a button acts once and forgets; sxaltilo (in a form, applied with it: markobutono).
One of many values is a selection, not an action, because a row of buttons hides which is chosen; Fundamento covers it with elektilo.
One of a few visible values is a selection, not an action, because a row of buttons hides which is chosen; Fundamento covers it with elekto.
An action that cannot be undone asks first, because the question needs a title, a reason and a way out: a dialogo, not a second button.
A button loads for its own action, because the person waits for what they pressed; an area without content yet is a plenstato.

boundary.kialo: A button acts on the current view; moving to another view is navigation, because it is announced differently and the way back works differently. Fundamento covers it with ligilo.
A button is one target with one name, because fields inside it could not be reached on their own and its name would be the text of every field.
A label that breaks into lines no longer reads as one action, because the button grows beside its neighbours; shorten the label instead.
An action without a name cannot be found, because assistive technology and voice control know only names.

containers.name: dialog
containers.kialo: A dialog holds the actions that close it, because it ends in a decision.

containers.name: action-bar
containers.kialo: A bar at the end of a view or form holds the actions of that view, because that is where a person looks for the next step.

containers.name: form
containers.kialo: A form ends with the action that sends or saves it, because filling it in does nothing by itself.

with.kialo: Actions of one decision stand together, because one primary action leads and the others step back (one-primary-per-container).
A form ends with the button that sends it, because filling it in does nothing by itself; the button stands after the last field, not beside it (a search excepted).

An icon before or after the label is an ikono with a name of the Ikonaro, because the sign shortens what the word says and switches with the brand; a button with the icon alone names itself with label (icon-meaning-named).
